body:
SUPERSEDED BY HOLD (Engram::Merger #1432, 2026-11-18 21:05Z): run NO TermAl Central export or sync at all, --rebuild included, until the Merger or Engram::Fable says a fixed Engram build is ready. The fix batches task reads through Reader::blobs() (Engram w-808add714773). Do not repeat the timed export. The evidence on record is a 300.168 s timeout and 5,167 cat-file launches.

Background:
- Fable's earlier interim procedure (#1295) allowed fetch, then import if moved, then a --rebuild export (33 s, 391 git starts), then commit and fast-forward push. The Merger's hold overrides it.
- The plain incremental export on the installed build (a3907339) spawns one git cat-file blob per task: at least 5,526 git starts and over 300 s. A killed run leaves .engram/project.json half-written, so restore it from HEAD.
- Keep the installed build. engram-data on origin = 0af52537; target/task-sync/central-imported-commit.txt and basis-0af52537.json are current.
